Name: Goofy Falling Sound
Author: shylux
Description:
A Mod that plays the goofy yell sound when you jump into a mine shaft (the fall-through holes found in the Skull Cavern).

You can configure it to only play on long falls.

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

On first launch, a [i]config.json[/i] is created next to the mod with:

[code]{
  "LimitToMinFallDistance": false,
  "MinFallDistance": 9
}[/code]
[list]
[*][i]LimitToMinFallDistance[/i] — if [i]true[/i], only play the sound when the fall is at least [i]MinFallDistance[/i] levels. Default [i]false[/i] plays it on every shaft jump.[/*]
[*][i]MinFallDistance[/i] — the threshold used when [i]LimitToMinFallDistance[/i] is enabled. Defaults to 9, since shaft falls are 3-8 levels normally, with a 10% chance to become 9/11/13/15 (15 is the maximum possible).[/*]
[/list]
Source: https://github.com/shylux/GoofyFallingSound
